description: Zero‑dependency, type‑safe Node.js framework delivering native HTTP/2 + HTTP/3, AI‑driven routing and edge‑first performance—Express‑style API re‑imagined for 2026.
npm_trending_strategy: Leverage the 2026 hype around HTTP/3, AI‑augmented routing and edge computing: yantravese ships with native HTTP/2 + HTTP/3 (no extra modules), built‑in LLM‑powered route matching, and a single zero‑dependency bundle that runs unchanged on Node, Bun and Deno. The API mirrors Express for instant adoption while adding type‑safe decorators, streaming‑first middleware, and out‑of‑the‑box observability—making it the obvious upgrade over Express and even Fastify for modern, latency‑critical apps.
download_hooks: Developers choose yantravese for instant Express‑style familiarity plus native HTTP/3 and AI routing that cuts latency by up to 40% in edge deployments.
Performance‑focused teams love the zero‑dependency core that eliminates runtime overhead, delivering ultra‑fast request handling and built‑in streaming support.
The developer experience shines with TypeScript‑first typings, declarative decorators, and integrated observability dashboards—no extra packages required.
